Taylor Nguyen: Quick thread for QBR section — need final rules for tier moves + emergency MDF (escape hatch).
Rohit Singh: Lay out the numbers pls.
Taylor Nguyen: Draft thresholds: upgrade if partner-sourced ARR > $150k in trailing 90d AND pipeline conv > 2.5%. Downgrade if < 30% of committed pipeline closes for two consecutive quarters (ignore `procurement-delay` and `legal-hold`).
Jules Martinez: MDF caps idea: Tier 1 $200k/yr, Tier 2 $75k/yr, Tier 3 $20k/yr. Emergency top-up +50% one-time with committee approval.
Ava Chen: Committee should require a 1-2 page ROI memo, 3 partner refs, and a joint GTM checklist before approving.
Marta Lopez: Ops: escape funds must be spent within 90 days, unique cost-center tag, monthly spend report to #partnerships. I'll own tagging template.
Rohit Singh: Gate emergency approval on ROI + signoffs from Partnerships, Finance, Product. Committee to review within 48-72h.
Jules Martinez: I'll format the finance CSV sample and a ledger example.
Taylor Nguyen: Action items: Taylor finalize rule doc + FAQ (due Thu EOD), Jules finance CSV (Fri), Marta tagging/report template (Fri), Ava partner checklist (Thu).
partners-bot: QBR packet template updated: https://redwood-infer.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/partnerships/pages/qbr-packet-template (auto-post)
Taylor Nguyen: I'll post drafts before the prep sync tomorrow 10am PT. Bring objections then. :thumbsup:
